# eslint-plugin-react-features

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint React hooks and JSX rules — prop-types, JSX correctness, render performance, and class-to-hooks migration for modern React codebases.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-react-features
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

These presets do not turn on JSX parsing. For `.jsx` files add `languageOptions: { parserOptions: { ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } } }` to a config entry; `.tsx` files are covered by `typescript-eslint`.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import reactFeatures from 'eslint-plugin-react-features';

export default [reactFeatures.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `react-features/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset         | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| -------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `flagship`     | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `recommended`  | 11    | 7      | 4        |
| `componentApi` | 8     | 1      | 7        |

### `flagship`

1 rule:

- `hooks-exhaustive-deps` (error): Enforce exhaustive dependencies in React hooks to prevent stale closures.

### `recommended`

11 rules:

- `jsx-key` (error): Detect missing or problematic React keys that could break reconciliation.
- `no-children-prop` (warn): Disallow passing children as props.
- `no-danger` (warn): Disallow dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage.
- `no-string-refs` (error): Disallow string refs.
- `no-unknown-property` (error): Disallow unknown DOM properties.
- `hooks-exhaustive-deps` (warn): Enforce exhaustive dependencies in React hooks to prevent stale closures.
- `jsx-no-target-blank` (error): Forbid target="_blank" without rel="noopener noreferrer".
- `jsx-no-script-url` (error): Forbid javascript: URLs.
- `jsx-no-duplicate-props` (error): Prevent duplicate props in JSX.
- `no-danger-with-children` (error): Prevent using both children and dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
- `no-deprecated` (warn): Prevent using deprecated React methods.

### `componentApi`

8 rules:

- `component-api/no-default-test-id` (error): no description.
- `component-api/require-data-slot` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-is-prefix-prop` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-inline-style` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-raw-color-literal` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-arbitrary-token-class` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-kind-prop-discriminator` (warn): no description.
- `component-api/no-wrapper-sub-component` (warn): no description.

### Rules in no preset

Enable these by name (`'react-features/<rule>': 'error'`); README.md describes each: `required-attributes`, `no-direct-mutation-state`, `require-optimization`, `no-set-state`, `no-this-in-sfc`, `no-access-state-in-setstate`, `checked-requires-onchange-or-readonly`, `default-props-match-prop-types`, `display-name`, `jsx-handler-names`, `jsx-max-depth`, `jsx-no-bind`, `jsx-no-literals`, `no-adjacent-inline-elements`, `no-arrow-function-lifecycle`, `no-did-mount-set-state`, `no-did-update-set-state`, `no-invalid-html-attribute`, `no-is-mounted`, `no-multi-comp`, `no-namespace`, `no-object-type-as-default-prop`, `no-redundant-should-component-update`, `no-render-return-value`, `no-typos`, `no-unescaped-entities`, `prefer-es6-class`, `prefer-stateless-function`, `prop-types`, `react-in-jsx-scope`, `require-default-props`, `require-render-return`, `sort-comp`, `state-in-constructor`, `static-property-placement`, `jsx-no-comment-textnodes`, `jsx-no-undef`, `jsx-uses-react`, `jsx-uses-vars`, `style-prop-object`, `jsx-pascal-case`, `forbid-foreign-prop-types`, `no-find-dom-node`, `no-unsafe`, `void-dom-elements-no-children`, `react-class-to-hooks`, `no-unnecessary-rerenders`, `react-render-optimization`, `react-no-inline-functions`, `no-default-test-id`, `require-data-slot`, `no-is-prefix-prop`, `no-inline-style`, `no-raw-color-literal`, `no-arbitrary-token-class`, `no-kind-prop-discriminator`, `no-wrapper-sub-component`.
